title: Move the manager's /tmp scripts into the CLI: dispatch, finish, land, budget
notes:
From the 30-session retro (2026-11-16): managers keep rebuilding their workflow as throwaway /tmp scripts.
- Dashboard manager: land.sh ran 130 times, wave.sh 116, finish.sh 99 and dispatch.sh 57. They were lost when /tmp filled, and wave.sh was rewritten 3 times.
- new-crm manager: a hand-made /tmp/budget.sh ran 59 times, and `sleep 1500; echo heartbeat` ran 19 times to stay awake overnight. The user restated the usage cap each time ("don't go over 74%").

Want:
- `pane dispatch <card>`, `pane finish <id>` and `pr land <n>` as CLI verbs;
- a `budget` verb that reads the 7-day usage against a cap the user sets once;
- a scheduled wake-up instead of sleep heartbeats.
Keep the worker brief as a template in the repo.

comments.body:
Scope from main-dashboard:
- Merged in front of this card: #294 (pane report, prompt-source, session-cli.ts verbs), #291 (review.autoMerge / landsPullRequest), #292 (background gh pr checks --watch). Build on those and reuse landsPullRequest's wait-then-merge (--match-head-commit) for pr land. pr land is an explicit merge by whoever calls it, so autoMerge does not gate it.
- pane dispatch <card> should be what main runs: claim + run --card with the brief, the brief kept as a template in the repo. pane finish <id> = release after its card or PR is done.
- budget: find a reliable source for the 7-day usage first. If there is none, leave budget out and say so on the card; don't scrape.
- Scheduled wake-up: Claude Code has a native ScheduleWakeup/Monitor. If the fix is only a prompt line for main, keep it to that line.
- Help, usage text and docs change with it. Do not bump the version.

budget left out: the only source of the 7-day usage is the Agent SDK's usage_EXPERIMENTAL_MAY_CHANGE_DO_NOT_RELY_ON_THIS_API_YET (what the Claude screen's status line shows). It needs a live SDK session, which a terminal main does not have, and it is named not to be relied on, so a cap gate built on it would go quiet the day it changes. Recorded as command-decision-5. pane dispatch was not built either: board ship already makes the worktree, the pane and the agent, and main's prompt and pane --help now point to it (agreed with main-dashboard).
Pull request #295 opened: Move the manager's /tmp scripts into the CLI: pane finish, pr land https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/295
